Telemus Capital Upped Its Stake in Novartis A G (NVS) by $1.73 Million as Stock Price Declined; Apple (AAPL) Shareholder Valiant Capital Management LP Decreased Its Holding by $499.67 Million 
April 1, 2018 - By Vivian Currie 
Christopher R. Hansen decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 86.96% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Valiant Capital Management Lp sold 2.96 million shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The hedge fund run by Christopher R. Hansen held 443,400 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $75.04M, down from 3.40 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Valiant Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $851.32B market cap company. The stock increased 0.78% or $1.3   $167.78. About 38.40M shares traded or 1.81% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49%   outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500. 
Telemus Capital Llc increased its stake in Novartis A G (NVS) by 360.46% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Telemus Capital Llc bought 20,849 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.22% with the market. The institutional investor held 26,633 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.24 million, up from 5,784 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Telemus Capital Llc who had been investing in Novartis A G for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $188.10 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.49% or $0.4   $80.85. About 1.53M shares traded. Novartis AG (NYSE:NVS) has risen 5.79%   underperformed by 5.76% the S&P500. 
Telemus Capital Llc, which manages about $2.42B and $1.29B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Target Corp (NYSE:TGT) by 9,582 shares to 865 shares, valued at $56,000 in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Autozone Inc (NYSE:AZO) by 581 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 6,230 shares, and cut its stake in Claymore Exchange Trd Fd Tr (BSJI). 
Among 16 analysts covering Novartis Ag ( NYSE:NVS ), 5 have Buy rating, 4 Sell and 7 Hold. Therefore 31% are positive. Novartis Ag had 36 analyst reports since July 28, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock of Novartis AG (NYSE:NVS) has “Neutral” rating given on Tuesday, March 29 by Citigroup. Cowen & Co downgraded Novartis AG (NYSE:NVS) on Wednesday, April 5 to “Market Perform” rating. Chardan Capital Markets maintained the stock with “Buy” rating in Monday, October 10 report. Bank of America downgraded the shares of NVS in report on Wednesday, December 6 to “Sell” rating. As per Wednesday, March 23, the company rating was downgraded by Leerink Swann. Chardan Capital Markets initiated Novartis AG (NYSE:NVS) on Tuesday, September 20 with “Buy” rating. The stock of Novartis AG (NYSE:NVS) earned “Overweight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Wednesday, July 26. The rating was downgraded by Morgan Stanley to “Underperform” on Tuesday, April 12. The rating was upgraded by Barclays Capital on Friday, June 23 to “Hold”. Cowen & Co maintained it with “Hold” rating and $7700 target in Monday, July 10 report.
